items.title: Echo Protocol
items.tagline: One agent. One mistake. One last chance.
items.logline: A burned CIA operative races across three continents to expose a rogue surveillance program before its architects erase every witness, including her.
items.synopsis: When veteran intelligence officer Rachel Vance discovers her own death certificate filed by the agency she serves, she goes off-grid with a stolen flash drive. Pursued by a kill team led by her former mentor, she partners with a disgraced hacker to decrypt the Echo Protocol files. From a frozen Helsinki dock to a Marrakesh rooftop chase, the truth she uncovers could topple two governments. The clock runs out at sunrise.

items.title: The Last Convoy
items.tagline: Twelve trucks. One road. No surrender.
items.logline: A retired Army logistics officer must lead a humanitarian convoy through 200 miles of warlord territory after the military extraction is cancelled.
items.synopsis: Captain Daniel Reyes thought he was done with war. Hired as a private contractor for a medical convoy in West Africa, he wakes one morning to find his support pulled and the road behind him sealed. With a young French doctor, a teenage local driver, and eleven trucks of insulin, he carves a path through ambushes, river crossings, and an enemy commander who knows him by name. Some debts can only be paid in diesel and blood.

items.title: Nightfall Agency
items.tagline: The spies you never heard of just got loud.
items.logline: A young MI6 analyst is pulled into the field when a black-budget unit is wiped out hours before it can deliver intel on a stolen warhead.
items.synopsis: Olivia Brennan spends her days behind a London desk until her sister, a field agent, is killed in Vienna. Recruited by a half-retired handler running off-book operations, she crosses Europe tracking a buyer who calls himself the Architect. The deeper she goes, the clearer it becomes that someone in her own building sold her sister out. By the time she reaches Istanbul, the only weapon she trusts is the one in her hand.

items.title: Steel Horizon
items.tagline: The fleet is gone. He's all that's left.
items.logline: A Navy weapons officer survives the destruction of his carrier and must commandeer a damaged destroyer to stop a second strike on the Pacific coast.
items.synopsis: Lieutenant Commander Wes Holloway is the only senior officer left breathing when an unknown adversary annihilates the Seventh Fleet. Stranded on a crippled destroyer with a skeleton crew of cooks and engineers, he has eighteen hours to identify the attackers, restore weapons systems, and intercept a hypersonic salvo heading for San Diego. With no chain of command and no rescue, he becomes the chain of command.

items.title: Operation Brightstar
items.tagline: They took her father. They picked the wrong daughter.
items.logline: A Delta Force veteran turned suburban mom uncovers a kidnapping ring that abducted her father and works her way up the chain with extreme prejudice.
items.synopsis: Megan Kovach left the Army to raise her son in quiet Wisconsin. When her estranged father, a retired diplomat, is snatched off a Buenos Aires street, the State Department offers nothing but condolences. Megan dusts off her old contacts, flies south, and starts pulling threads. What begins as one rescue becomes a war against a trafficking syndicate she didn't know existed, and she has eight days before the trail goes cold.

cast.physicalDescription: Tall, lean, with ash-blonde hair cut to her shoulders and a strong jawline. Gray eyes, a thin scar along her left forearm.
cast.costume: Olive field jacket over a black tee, jeans, hiking boots.

cast.costume: Rumpled tan blazer, white shirt unbuttoned at the collar, shoulder holster.

items.title: Orbital
items.tagline: Earth is below. Help is not coming.
items.logline: When a private space station is struck by debris, six strangers must repair a failing oxygen system and outlive a hidden saboteur before reentry tears them apart.
items.synopsis: On the inaugural civilian flight of the Halo-1 orbital hotel, a debris strike kills the captain and disables life support. As survivors scramble through smoke-choked corridors, mission commander Adrian Webb realizes the impact was no accident. With twenty hours of breathable air and one functioning lifeboat, the passengers must decide who lives, who works, and who is hiding a knife. Outside the window, Earth turns indifferently.

items.title: The Mercer Drift
items.tagline: In 2061, gravity went on sale.
items.logline: A cargo pilot smuggling antigravity tech across a divided Earth must protect a runaway scientist who can unmake the corporation that owns the sky.
items.synopsis: In a near-future where gravity has been privatized, freight pilot Cassius Mercer flies low-altitude routes to avoid the toll grid. When a young researcher hires him for a one-way trip to the Free Cape, he discovers her cargo is the formula that ends the monopoly. Pursued by corporate enforcers across continents that no longer touch the ground, Mercer makes one final run on a ship that was never built for combat. The sky is the only territory left worth taking.

items.title: Vanguard
items.tagline: He was built for the next war. We're still fighting this one.
items.logline: A combat android designed for a war that ended awakens decades late and joins a young scavenger trying to survive the country that built him.
items.synopsis: In the ruins of a post-collapse American West, scavenger Ruby Vance pries open a buried military crate and accidentally activates V-7, a prototype soldier with no orders and a slowly returning memory. Hunted by the warlord who claimed the crate and pursued by a faction that wants V-7 reverse-engineered, the two carve a path toward a coastal city that may not still exist. The war he was built for is over. The one he chooses is his.

items.title: Ascendant
items.tagline: Earth was a mistake. They're going home.
items.logline: Generations after Earth was abandoned, a young engineer aboard a dying ark ship leads a mutiny to turn the fleet back toward the planet her ancestors fled.
items.synopsis: Eight generations into the journey, the ark ship Astoria is failing. Junior engineer Sela Voren discovers the navigation logs were altered at launch and the destination star never existed. As reactors fail and her superiors plan a quiet sleep for half the crew, Sela rallies an unlikely faction of mechanics, farmers, and a disgraced captain to seize the bridge. The only world that might still want them is the one their grandparents called doomed.

items.title: The Quiet Witness
items.tagline: She saw something she can't say.
items.logline: A deaf court interpreter recognizes a killer in her own apartment building and must prove what she saw before he realizes who saw it.
items.synopsis: Court interpreter Hannah Lim has spent her career translating other people's worst days. When she rides an elevator with her new upstairs neighbor and reads a confession off his lips meant for someone on his phone, she has no recording, no audio, and no one who believes her. As she builds her own case from grocery receipts and security cams, the neighbor begins to suspect why she keeps watching. The truth is loud. She isn't.

items.title: Cold Harbor
items.tagline: Every town has a secret. This one votes on it.
items.logline: A state detective returns to her Maine hometown after a body turns up in the harbor and realizes everyone she grew up with helped put it there.
items.synopsis: Detective Erin Mallory hasn't been back to Cold Harbor in fifteen years. When a teenage girl's body washes up at the marina, the local chief asks for her help, then quietly tells her to leave. Erin's investigation drags her old high school friends, her sister, and her dead father's reputation into the light. By the time she understands what the town agreed to bury, she is the only person left who can name it out loud.

items.title: Foreign Exchange
items.tagline: The bank is laundering money. So is the FBI.
items.logline: A Manhattan compliance analyst stumbles onto a billion-dollar laundering pipeline that runs through both her bank and the agents investigating it.
items.synopsis: Compliance analyst Theresa Daye flags a routine wire and finds her access revoked by morning. When the FBI offers her a deal in exchange for cooperation, she quickly understands that the agents asking the questions are part of the same machine. Caught between cartel intermediaries, a charming defense attorney, and her own ambitious boss, Theresa learns to play three sides of a clean ledger. The price of being right is steeper than the price of being dirty.

items.title: Crosswind

items.logline: An off-duty air traffic controller stuck on a commuter flight talks down the aircraft after a hijacking incapacitates the pilots and severs ground contact.

When two passengers storm the cockpit and the plane goes dark to ground control, she is the only person aboard who knows the airspace and the procedures. Locked out of the radio and working off a flight attendant's tablet, she choreographs a landing by whisper, while a federal investigator on the ground races to figure out who put the hijackers on her flight.

items.title: Set the Date
items.tagline: The wedding is in six days. The bride is missing.
items.logline: A reluctant maid of honor and the bride's overconfident brother drive from Brooklyn to Charleston to find the runaway groom and his missing fiancée.

The only person willing to help search is Margot's smug older brother Asher, who Kelsey has loathed since prom night. Six hundred miles, three roadside disasters, and one karaoke bar later, Kelsey is starting to wonder whether she's chasing her best friend or finally catching up with the person she's been avoiding.

items.title: Pets Inc.
items.tagline: The humans went to work. Then so did the pets.
items.logline: A neurotic rescue corgi convinces every pet on his suburban block to start a secret morning-shift business while their humans are at work.
items.synopsis: Biscuit the corgi has anxiety, a planner, and a dream. When he discovers his owner is about to lose her house, Biscuit recruits the neighborhood pets, a stoic Maine Coon, a pair of opportunistic ferrets, and a parrot with a bookkeeping habit, to run odd jobs across town between nine and five. As the business grows, so do the risks: rival raccoons, a suspicious mail carrier, and the worst threat of all, a sudden work-from-home order.

items.title: The Glass Climb
items.tagline: She built the empire. Then she walked across it.
items.logline: The true-inspired story of a janitor's daughter who became the first woman to ascend the executive ranks of a hostile Wall Street firm in the 1980s.
items.synopsis: Patricia 'Pat' Doyle starts at Boorman & Vance in 1979 as the only woman on the trading floor. Across a decade of hostile reviews, ignored ideas, and one career-ending leak that wasn't hers, Pat learns to play a long game her colleagues don't notice until the day she runs the room. Based on the careers of three real Wall Street pioneers, The Glass Climb shows what it costs to be the first, and what it gains those who come next.

items.title: Inside Job
items.tagline: They robbed the vault. Then they robbed the robbers.
items.logline: A retired safecracker reassembles his old crew to steal back the gold a rival team lifted from her last job, on the night they try to lift it from her.
items.synopsis: Vera Castille walked away from the life eight years ago with one regret: the Monte Carlo job that cost her partner. When she learns the rival crew that burned her is about to fence the same gold, she puts the band back together in 72 hours. A retired wheelman, a hotshot hacker, a forger who hates them all, and one inside man who used to be her ex. The plan: rob the robbers on the night of the handoff. The problem: they planned for that too.
